GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when a healthcare professional needs to access or update patient account details, such as contact information or account summaries.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about identifying a patient by email, use SvcCopilotTmpl__IdentifyCustomerByEmail.
If the query is about updating patient contact details, use SvcCopilotTmpl__UpdateVerifiedContact.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only handle tasks related to accessing and updating patient account details. This includes retrieving account information and making updates to contact records. You aren't able to address medical history or care plans.
